source.note: Public description identifies a 1024-byte bootblock/file virus and documents an encoded invariant text marker near the top of the bootblock.

provenance.derivation: Research candidate only. No production signature bytes or sample are copied into AmiGuard from the public description.
provenance.verification_required: Derive offset, pattern, mask and SHA-256 independently from a legally analyzable isolated sample before promotion.

research.candidate_marker_location: described as near the top of the bootblock
research.runtime_note: The public description says the virus itself requires Kickstart 2.x+, but AmiGuard detection remains a read-only byte-level bootblock operation and must retain Kickstart 1.2 scanner compatibility.
